Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Matilda mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Ena breathes "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
